description: Student Challenge is an educational quiz app where students create profiles, choose their grade, and answer Mathematics, Physics, Biology, Chemistry, English, and IQ questions. Correct answers earn points for the leaderboard. Students can use points to buy educational books. An admin can securely manage questions, students, books, and content.

AP Chemistry Score Calculator 2025 – Free online tool to predict your AP Chemistry exam score (1–5). Supports MCQ + FRQ raw to scaled score conversion with pass probability, difficulty curve adjustments, and grade estimation. 📌 Try it online here: [AP Chemistry Score Calculator 2025](https://onlinecalculators.shop/ap-chemistry-score-calculator/)

问学猫是一款面向本专科分层教学的多智能体学习辅导系统。系统通过六角色智能体集群协作，围绕学生专业背景和学历层次提供差异化学习支持：本科生侧重理论推导与算法原理，专科生强化技能实操与岗位对接。核心功能涵盖智能对话答疑、五类学习资源生成（讲义、思维导图、题库、实训案例、微课脚本）、个性化学习路径规划及教师班级管理看板。系统内置题库逐题作答与错题自动归因机制，可持续追踪薄弱知识点并生成可视化诊断报告。支持 PWA 离线运行与 Docker 一键部署，确保在实训室、课堂、宿舍等不同场景下稳定可用。
Plug-and-play desktop calculator for tissue monoamine concentrations from HPLC peak areas (Python/tkinter port of an R script), with fully editable calibration constants.

A virtual school management system with 3 roles: Admin (manages teachers, students, certificates, subjects, exams, sessions, classes, news), Teacher, and Student. It integrates with Unity 3D for practical chemistry simulations and MS Teams for lectures. Students can access classes, subjects, take theoretical/practical exams, and view results.
Godot based Quiz game for academic level Organic Chemistry
CBSE Class 12 Chemistry quiz app (Vite + React) - 300 NCERT-based questions, 6 quiz modes, timer, leaderboard
